title: Stop the Slide
briefing: The market is calm for now. Choose a maximum loss in your plan and keep to it, whatever the Harbor 50 does next.
objective: Drawdowns grow fast and need bigger gains to recover. Cap your losses and pause when your limit is near.
debrief: Stocks rose for ten days. On day 10 a global growth scare knocked the Harbor 50 down, and a broad sell-off lasted until about day 22, hitting Nimbus Cloud and Lumen Bikes hardest and calm Tidal Power least. Panic Pete sold late and bought back early. Players with stops and a firm maximum loss stepped aside early, kept their drawdown small and had cash ready for the recovery.

news.headline: Harbor 50 drops 3% on a global growth scare
news.body: Weak factory figures from the region's biggest trading partners have investors worried about a slowdown. Fast-growing companies fell most; steady utilities fell least.

basic.text: Keep your worst drop within your plan's maximum loss
